status: candidate A3 target contract; not an architecture-spec freeze

route_a.storage_model: independent append-only cold pages per (layer, KV head); original KVzap mask is unchanged once the packed path is active

edge_execution.scheduling_unit: complete (layer, KV head, GQA query-head group) task
edge_execution.scheduler: layer-local whole-head LPT; no cross-engine partial-softmax merge
notes: attention_engine_count is an independently schedulable attention stream-engine count, not a systolic-array MAC count.

SRAM, DRAM burst, admission-engine throughput, page-setup latency, and overlap are deliberately supplied by the A3-edge CLI and remain explicit uncalibrated assumptions until a target device is selected.

required_followups: Validate policy-on generation equivalence or accuracy separately; A3-edge is accounting only.
Repeat A0/A2/A3-edge evidence on another supported model before making cross-model claims.
Freeze a real edge memory/clock/SRAM target before RTL or PPA claims.
